verdict.rationale: Jan documents model management: downloading from the Hub by Hugging Face ID, importing local GGUF files from Settings, and pausing or resuming downloads. Custom Assistants hold reusable instructions and can be assigned to projects, which loosely covers saved prompts. Nothing in the pack documents per-model configuration settings or a single unified management view. Missing for 10: per-model parameter/configuration management, evidence that models, prompts, and configs are managed in one place, dedicated saved-prompt library, independent/hands-on corroboration.
